interaction_history.overview: At an exclusive country club, an ambitious young caddy, Danny Noonan, eagerly pursues a caddy scholarship in hopes of attending college and, in turn, avoiding a job at the lumber yard. In order to succeed, he must first win the favour of the elitist Judge Smails, and then the caddy golf tournament which Smails sponsors.
interaction_history.title: Caddyshack

interaction_history.overview: Charismatic teen Ferris Bueller plays hooky in Chicago with his girlfriend and best friend.
interaction_history.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off

interaction_history.overview: The Griswold family hits the road again for a typically ill-fated vacation, this time to the glitzy mecca of slots and showgirls—Las Vegas.
interaction_history.title: Vegas Vacation

interaction_history.overview: Babe is a little pig who doesn't quite know his place in the world. With a bunch of odd friends, like Ferdinand the duck who thinks he is a rooster and Fly the dog he calls mom, Babe realizes that he has the makings to become the greatest sheep pig of all time, and Farmer Hogget knows it. With the help of the sheep dogs Babe learns that a pig can be anything that he wants to be.
interaction_history.title: Babe

interaction_history.overview: Two troubled men face their terrible destinies and events of their past as they join together on a mission to find the Holy Grail and thus to save themselves.
interaction_history.title: Fisher King, The

interaction_history.overview: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first they cooperate, but when the they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph and the other by militaristic Jack -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion.
interaction_history.title: Lord of the Flies

interaction_history.overview: In the city of New York, comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.
interaction_history.title: Annie Hall

interaction_history.overview: Charlie Simms (Chris O'Donnell) is a student at a private preparatory school who comes from a poor family. To earn the money for his flight home to Gresham, Oregon for Christmas, Charlie takes a job over Thanksgiving looking after retired U.S. Army officer Lieutenant Colonel Frank Slade (Al Pacino), a cantankerous middle-aged man who lives with his niece and her family.
interaction_history.title: Scent of a Woman

interaction_history.overview: Young Dorothy finds herself in a magical world where she makes friends with a lion, a scarecrow and a tin man as they make their way along the yellow brick road to talk with the Wizard and ask for the things they miss most in their lives. The Wicked Witch of the West is the only thing that could stop them.
interaction_history.title: Wizard of Oz, The

interaction_history.overview: A middle-aged couple suspects foul play when their neighbor's wife suddenly drops dead.
interaction_history.title: Manhattan Murder Mystery
